```{r}
library(cowsay)
species <- c("stegosaurus", "snowman", "dragon","whale")

for (spp in species) {
  say(paste("I am a", spp), by = spp)
}
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
species <- c("monkey", "shark", "turkey", "snowman")
species_df <- tibble()

for (spp in species) {
  has_s <- startsWith(spp, "s")
  current_row <- tibble(
    Species = spp,
    Starts_with_S = has_s
  )
  species_df <- species_df |> bind_rows(current_row)
}
gt(species_df)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
set.seed(42)
breakfast <- c("eggs", "buns", "corn", "toast", "porridges","yoghurt","cereal","dumpling","sweet potatoes","cake")

for(i in seq_len(10)) {
  item<-print(sample(breakfast, size = 1))
  count<-print(sample(1:5, size=1))
  combine <- tibble(
  item=item,
  count=count
)
  breakfasttable <- bind_rows(breakfasttable,combine)
}
gt(breakfasttable)
```
